title: DIY Hair Masks: Spa Day at Home
summary: Two kitchen-cupboard masks for soft, strong hair: an avocado hydrator and a rice water rinse.
body:
Sometimes the best ingredients are found right in your kitchen. A homemade mask is a fun, effective way to treat specific hair concerns while enjoying a slow evening at home.

## The avocado hydrator

Mash half a ripe avocado with a tablespoon of honey and a teaspoon of olive oil. Apply to damp hair and leave for 20 minutes. Avocados are rich in biotin, which strengthens hair.

## The rice water rinse

Soak rinsed rice in water for 24 hours, then use the water as a final rinse after shampooing.
